record: Hunting on the family's own land: docs/WOODS_AND_BUILDING.md build step 3

measured.facts: A colonies family (seed hunt-look) with its house set in the middle of its labor: a quarter mile east and beside the house prairie, game 0.2, 'the longest wait'; a quarter mile south-west creek timber at the edge, game 1, 'Good ground for deer'; north-east prairie beside timber, game 0.4.
measured.hunt: Hollis sent to the prairie a fifth of a mile east: walked out on the family's land in one tick, waited still seven ticks (five of work at his pace), was asked, waited for the deer to come closer, fired, brought 5 food home of 10 and walked in; 'Hollis fired in the prairie' after the fix below.
measured.fixedOnTheWay: The first run stalked the hunter 0.16 miles on from the place, over the family's line, and wrote 'fired in the timber' on the prairie; the stalk is now a quarter as far round a chosen place and the words are the place's own. A new chore entry on every person's tick put a fresh class 135 bytes over the 10 KB channel bound (tests/family.test.mjs); it now carries no carry number and a refusal it shares with the hunt in the timber is sent once.

browserProof.note: Same computer only: headless Chrome through the workstation Playwright, a settled five-family class. Not LAN or district acceptance.
observed: Zadok's work panel offered 'Hunt on our land' with its description; pressing it opened 'Where Zadok hunts' with the hint to tap inside the dashed line.
A tap a sixth of a mile east of the house read 'Prairie beside the house. Open ground that game seldom crosses: the longest wait.' and showed 'Hunt there'.

Hunt there: Zadok's chore was hunt-land, waiting downwind and still, ground game 0.2 'the prairie', a deer placed east of him; the screenshot showed him on the family's land with the deer at the dashed line. No page errors.
Two further taps, 0.9 miles out and 0.15 west, did not change the panel: the view was following the chosen person and the first was off the screen; not investigated further.

removed: hunt by wagon: the order already sends it on foot, so the line inside the chore did nothing and was taken out
